title: Dog Emotion Recognition System
description: Engineered an intelligent canine behavioral recognition and care recommendation system, combining fine-tuned YOLO11 computer vision with a high-performance cross-platform Flutter mobile client.

detail.longDescription: Designed and developed an end-to-end intelligent dog care recommendation system focused on behavioral and emotional state detection. Fine-tuned a state-of-the-art YOLO11 computer vision architecture in Python, optimizing detection accuracy across diverse lighting conditions and canine breeds. Built a responsive cross-platform Flutter mobile client featuring real-time camera inference, personalized pet behavioral insights, and contextual care guidelines based on classified emotional states.

title: Pawsitive
description: A 100% offline-first Edge AI iOS app developed at Apple Developer Academy. Evolves my thesis model into Core ML, combining real-time emotion & bounding-box detection, Apple Vision breed classification with whitelist taxonomy, local Llama 3.2 1B SLM advice inference, and SwiftData persistence.

detail.role: Edge AI & iOS Engineer (Apple Developer Academy)
detail.longDescription:
Engineered Pawsitive, a flagship 100% offline-first Edge AI iOS application that performs real-time canine emotion detection, breed classification, and generates personalized on-device pet care advice without requiring an internet connection. Developed at the Apple Developer Academy as a high-performance evolution of my undergraduate thesis (Dog Emotion Recognition), Pawsitive converts custom computer vision models to Apple Core ML and pairs them with quantized on-device Small Language Models (SLM) for sub-second, zero-latency local intelligence.

Key Engineering Highlights & Contributions (10-Cycle Journey):
• Real-Time Emotion & Bounding Box Inference (Core ML): Converted thesis vision models into optimized Core ML models with an AVFoundation camera capture pipeline, achieving real-time bounding box tracking and facial expression classification directly on-device.
• Precision Breed Taxonomy & Fallback (Apple Vision): Engineered a specialized VisionBreedDetector leveraging VNClassifyImageRequest with an in-memory Whitelist (Set<String>) to filter out ambient background noise (e.g., walls, documents) with graceful fallback to generic pet taxonomy when encountering out-of-distribution subjects.
• 100% On-Device SLM Intelligence (Meta Llama 3.2 1B): Replaced cloud APIs (Gemini) by integrating Meta Llama 3.2 1B Instruct (quantized GGUF Q4_K_M via llama.cpp and a native Swift actor), generating tailored pet care recommendations from fused breed and emotion vectors in under two seconds in complete flight mode.
• Robust Local Persistence (SwiftData): Designed an optimized schema with @Model (PetProfile & MoodEntry) using @Attribute(.externalStorage) for photo memory management, alongside an automated reactive @Query persistence pipeline.
• History Detail & Apple HIG Compliance: Crafted an Apple Human Interface Guidelines-compliant history journal with full-text expanders, interactive high-resolution photo inspect, swipe-to-delete gestures, and native deletion confirmation dialogues.

title: BasketYuk
description: A live digital ecosystem for the Indonesian basketball community. Currently available on the App Store with 100+ downloads, featuring tournament tracking, club management, and ticketing.

detail.longDescription: Engineered BasketYuk, an end-to-end digital ecosystem tailored for the Indonesian basketball community. Architected a multi-platform mobile application utilizing Flutter for seamless user experiences across iOS and Android. Built a robust backend infrastructure with Laravel 12 and MySQL, supporting real-time tournament brackets, live match statistics, player transfers, and digital ID generation. Integrated Tripay SDK for automated e-ticket transactions and AWS S3 for scalable media storage. The platform effectively bridges event organizers, clubs, athletes, and fans into a single cohesive ecosystem.

title: Dogtective Riddle
description: An interactive 2D detective narrative puzzle game published on the App Store, engineered at Apple Developer Academy with Swift and SpriteKit. Designed as a 15-minute eudaimonic casual experience where players solve the mystery of stolen bones across the canine city.

detail.longDescription:
Engineered Dogtective Riddle, a narrative-driven 2D detective puzzle game published on the App Store, developed during the Apple Developer Academy. Conceived as a 15-minute eudaimonic casual game to alleviate daily boredom, players step into the paws of an intrepid canine detective investigating a municipal mystery—uncovering who stole all the bones across town by interrogating citizens, following the narrative, gathering forensic evidence, and solving interactive puzzles.

Key Engineering Highlights & Contributions:
• Police Game Scene & State Engine: Architected the complete frontend scene and underlying state machine for the police headquarters, orchestrating mission briefings, suspect boards, and clue deduction workflows.
• Level Progression & Map System: Built the dynamic level selection system and interactive map interface, allowing players to explore distinct urban districts and advance through narrative chapters.
• Evidence Storage & State Persistence: Implemented resilient local game progress and inventory persistence, securing collected clues, witness statements, and puzzle states across gameplay sessions.
• Interactive Puzzles & NPC Interrogation: Programmed witness dialogue systems and interactive clue-hunting puzzles required to piece together testimony and unmask the culprit.
• Audio-Visual Integration: Integrated SpriteKit node physics coupled with Lottie vector animations for fluid story cutscenes and curated Envato sound design and music for atmospheric immersion.
• In-Game Settings & Gameplay Controls: Engineered the in-game settings module for audio balancing, sound effects, and gameplay controls conforming to Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG).

title: Should I Really?
description: An interactive social media simulation game developed at Apple Developer Academy using Swift. Built to address high school digital literacy pain points discovered through educator interviews, simulating high school life from 10th grade to graduation with Framing & Caption metrics and branching outcomes.

detail.role: iOS & Core Logic Developer (Apple Developer Academy)
detail.longDescription:
Engineered 'Should I Really?', an interactive narrative casual simulation game built with Swift during the Apple Developer Academy. Conceived from empirical field interviews with high school teachers across Surabaya addressing digital literacy dilemmas, the game puts players in the shoes of a high school student navigating social media from 10th grade until graduation. Over 6 decision-making rounds, players choose photo framings and captions, managing their digital footprint and unlocking consequence-driven narrative endings reflecting their real-world impact.

Key Engineering Highlights & Contributions:
• Core UI & Social Media Simulation: Built the interactive home feed, post creator, and caption selection interface replicating modern social platform dynamics.
• Dual Metric Evaluation Engine: Engineered the underlying scoring logic evaluating visual Framing and textual Caption choices to dynamically calculate social impact and determine post-graduation narrative endings.
• State Persistence & Archive Pipeline: Architected local data persistence to reliably record posting history, decision trees, and unlocked endings across both home and archive views.
• Native Apple Accessibility: Implemented inclusive iOS Accessibility standards (Dynamic Type scaling, VoiceOver compatibility, and assistive contrast) ensuring broad usability for all students.
• Comprehensive Unit Testing: Developed robust XCTest suites covering scoring algorithms, metric calculations, and persistence flows for rock-solid stability.

title: Ubinkayu ERP
description: Architected an enterprise production management & PO tracking system (Desktop Electron & Web) deployed across PT Ubinkayu's manufacturing pipeline, processing 200+ Purchase Orders from factory floor to executive leadership.

detail.longDescription:
Architected and deployed a hybrid enterprise production management system (Desktop Electron & Web) to eliminate manual paper logging and digitalize PT Ubinkayu's end-to-end manufacturing operations.

Key Impact & Deliverables:
• Operational Scale: Successfully tracked and managed 200+ Purchase Orders end-to-end from raw timber intake to final dispatch.
• Cross-Tier Adoption: Designed role-tailored interfaces actively utilized daily across the company hierarchy—from executive leadership (sales insights, financial overview) and production managers (scheduling, stock monitoring) down to factory-floor operators (real-time photo verification of progress).
• Operational Transparency: Replaced fragmented paper trails with an automated single source of truth, drastically cutting status reconciliation delays and production visibility bottlenecks.
• Smart Analytics & AI: Integrated Google Sheets API data sync for live analytics and embedded an AI business assistant to query production metrics on demand.

title: GreenThumb
description: Engineered a native multi-platform botanical cataloging and identification application for iOS and macOS using Swift and SwiftUI, featuring modular view architectures and responsive local persistence.

detail.longDescription: Engineered a native multi-platform botanical cataloging application designed for the Apple ecosystem (iOS & macOS) using Swift and SwiftUI. Implemented modular navigation flows, adaptive master-detail view hierarchies across phone and desktop form factors, and reactive state management for adding, categorizing, and monitoring personal plant collections.

title: ScribeSoul
description: A native Android mental health and emotional stabilization application engineered with Kotlin and Firebase, featuring interactive art therapy drawing, mood stabilization tracking, and therapist consultation discovery.

detail.longDescription:
Engineered ScribeSoul, a native Android mental well-being platform designed to help users stabilize emotional distress through creative expression, structured wellness habits, and professional guidance. Developed in a cross-functional squad comprising 2 developers and 1 UI/UX designer.

Key Engineering Contributions:
• Interactive Art Therapy Canvas: Implemented a responsive drawing canvas utilizing Android Canvas APIs with low-latency touch handling and custom brush smoothing for therapeutic emotional release.
• Core Experience & Dashboard: Built the home feed and mood tracking workflows using Kotlin and MVVM architecture to deliver personalized daily stabilization prompts.
• Therapist Discovery & Consultation: Designed and integrated a discovery module for certified mental health professionals with appointment inquiry pipelines.
• Backend & Cloud Architecture: Engineered the end-to-end Firebase backend, leveraging Cloud Firestore for real-time data synchronization, Firebase Authentication for secure user identity, and Firebase Storage for user artworks.

title: STRYD
description: A comprehensive social running and sports analytics application built with Kotlin and Laravel, featuring real-time GPS route tracking with Google Maps, group running sessions, gear mileage monitoring, social feeds, and mathematical performance prediction models.

detail.longDescription:
Architected and engineered STRYD, an end-to-end social fitness and running analytics platform designed to connect endurance runners and optimize athletic progression.

Key Engineering Highlights & Contributions:
• Real-Time GPS Tracking & Spatial Analytics: Integrated Google Maps SDK and Elevation APIs to deliver precise real-time route plotting, pace splits, and dynamic elevation profiles.
• Community & Group Running Sessions: Engineered a collaborative run-matching module allowing athletes to create, discover, and join group running sessions with social feed interaction.
• Gear Lifespan & Mileage Tracker: Implemented a specialized running shoe mileage tracking engine to monitor footwear degradation, alerting runners when gear surpasses recommended distance thresholds.
• Algorithmic Performance Prediction: Built mathematical and predictive modeling routines to forecast race completion times, stamina metrics, and pacing benchmarks based on historical physiological data.
• Full-Stack Architecture & API: Designed a scalable RESTful backend with Laravel and MySQL, managing user authentication, activity telemetry, social feeds, and multi-user synchronization.

title: BikeFlow
description: Developed a predictive urban mobility analytics platform leveraging time-series machine learning (SARIMAX) to forecast municipal bike-sharing demand against seasonal and meteorological variables.

detail.longDescription: Developed an end-to-end predictive web platform forecasting daily urban bike-sharing utilization. Engineered time-series econometric models (SARIMAX) in Python to capture seasonal trends and environmental variance, and connected the analytical pipeline to a responsive full-stack web dashboard for visual scenario forecasting.

title: YuccaGPT
description: Architected an interactive voice-enabled information portal integrating Python, Google Cloud Text-to-Speech (TTS), and a modern React frontend for real-time conversational responses.

detail.longDescription: Architected an interactive voice-enabled information portal designed to streamline campus inquiries. Built backend audio synthesis microservices in Python leveraging Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, paired with an interactive, accessible React web frontend delivering fluid audio playback and instant contextual queries.

title: Allegro Music Education Centre
description: Architected a comprehensive digital presence and company profile for Allegro Music Education Centre, celebrating 20 years of musical pedagogy with full curriculum catalogs, educator credentials, student achievements, and interactive enrollment pathways.

detail.longDescription:
Architected and deployed an end-to-end digital company profile and web portal for Allegro Music Education Centre, an established musical academy with nearly two decades of pedagogical heritage in Indonesia.

Key Highlights & Engineering Contributions:
• Institutional Heritage & Brand Story: Crafted an immersive, responsive brand narrative highlighting Allegro's 20-year journey, teaching philosophy, and classical-to-modern musical disciplines.
• Structured Curriculum & Course Catalog: Engineered clear, modular course showcases spanning Piano, Violin, Vocal, and Ensemble training across beginner, intermediate, and advanced grading levels.
• Student Hall of Fame & Achievements: Built an inspiring achievement gallery celebrating national and international competition accolades, annual recitals, and student milestones.
• Conversion & Enrollment Pathways: Designed mobile-friendly consultation inquiry workflows, parent FAQ sections, and seamless direct registration channels.
• High-Performance Static Delivery: Developed using lightweight, semantic vanilla web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript) and deployed via Vercel with automated CI/CD for lightning-fast global delivery and mobile responsiveness.

title: Mandiri Langgeng Perkasa (MLP)

detail.longDescription: Architected a full-stack digital catalog and customer inquiry portal for Mandiri Langgeng Perkasa, a major ceramic and building materials distributor in Balikpapan. detail.longDescription: Engineered a responsive e-commerce web platform for an artisanal food producer. Customized client-side state architectures for cart interactions, developed interactive product detail showcases, streamlined direct ordering pathways, and implemented mobile-first responsive design standards.
